name: Shadow of an opaque clump
blurb: A lamp at the left edge shines a beam across thin, transparent gas onto a dense clump that scatters light (optical depth about 20), in pressure balance with its surroundings: behind the clump is a shadow with a sharp edge, which radiation that only diffuses would fill in (gray M1 radiation transport, docs/numerics.md section 24).

featured.label: Clump radius
featured.tip: Radius of the clump, as a share of the box. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Clump density
featured.tip: Density of the clump: its optical depth is the scattering opacity times this times its diameter. At 100 or less the beam shines through it. Changing it starts the run again
